theorems.name: Submission.coarea_normDet_block_triangular
theorems.statement: ∀ {V X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] (f : V →ₗ[ℝ] X) (K : Submodule ℝ V) (W : Submodule ℝ X), Function.Bijective f → W = (K.map f)ᗮ → f.normDet = (f ∘ₗ K.subtype).normDet * ((W.orthogonalProjectionOnto : X →ₗ[ℝ] W) ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ Kᗮ.subtype).normDet
